answer: Randomized Lantern Rotation. Each epoch, an unbounded verifiable random function (VRF) over the prior epoch's beacon assigns agents to verification duties; the beacon mixes pre-committed entropy, so assignments cannot be predicted before commit. Assignees must respond within one slot or lose nectar rewards, and their attested work is checked against a held-out sample whose selection is also VRF-drawn. An attacker must run a live node per identity through many epochs to pass checks, paying bandwidth, compute, and forfeited timber deposits for silent sybils,
